title: Intersectionality
description: This course is a primer for graduate students interested in pursuing comprehensive exams focusing centrally on intersectionality or where issues related to race, gender, and class are a significant component. We will explore how scholars use intersectionality as a theory, analytical/conceptual framework, and methodological approach. We will also examine how intersectionality enhances and is deployed in empirical research examining inequality at the individual, institutional, and state levels.
